stem: Which sentence from the blog entry supports the idea that learning to cook is an ongoing process?

options.label: F
options.text: On weekends, when I have the time, I make extra food and store it in the freezer.

options.label: G
options.text: I’m not saying that all kids should be master chefs, but I do think young people should try to understand and utilize basic cooking skills.

options.label: H
options.text: While I was cooking, I started thinking about the lessons and tips my mother had tried to teach me, and I wished that I had been more patient.

options.label: J
options.text: I still make mistakes, such as scorching the vegetables or making the hamburger meat too spicy to eat.
